name: Jessica Jones

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Resistance Up: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Crush: Blokları kırarak yüksek hasar vermeyi sağlar.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Cross-Fight Ability: Saldıran veya savunan şampiyona uygulanabilen ve bir görev içinde birden fazla dövüş boyunca süren yetenek.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Rakip özel saldırı kullanırsa durdurulamaz+engellenemez olur. Sanar (heal-adjacent) efektleri yeteneklerini kapatır, yetenek azaltıcı şampiyonlar da işe yarar. Ona karşı özel saldırı kullanmamak tavsiye edilir.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Class Dossier
When Jessica reaches max Investigation, she gains a Dossier on the Opponent's Class, increasing her Combat Power Rate by [1 - 25]% while below 1 Bar of Power.
Dossiers are Cross-Fight, lasting for the rest of the Quest. Once Jessica has a Dossier on 3 different Classes, she also gains one on the Superior Class.
At the start of each fight, if Jessica already has her Opponent's Dossier, she gains 1 Investigation for every 50 signature levels obtained.
immunityDetails:
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı (koşullu) 🧠
• Buff Bağışıklığı (sadece Daredevil sinerjisiyle isabet buff'ına bağışık) 🗡️🚫

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Physical and Energy Resistance increased by +[687.5].

abilitySections.title: Investigation - Max: 10
content: Gain 1 Investigation when the Opponent gains a Bar of Power. +1 as a Defender.
Gain 1 Investigation when the Opponent is inflicted with a non-Stun Debuff.
As a Defender, gain 1 Investigation every 4 seconds the Opponent spends above 2 Bars of Power.
Lose 2 Investigation when the Opponent gains or activates a Cleanse effect.

The ongoing Investigation makes Opponents nervous. Each Investigation increases the Opponent's chance to launch a Special Attack by 18%, and reduces their Ability Power Rate and Regeneration Rate by 7%.
Once Investigation reaches max, the Investigation is complete and it can no longer be gained or lost.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Pause all non-Stun Debuffs inflicted by Special Attack 1 for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Opponent activates a Special Attack
content: For each Investigation, inflict a 2% Weakness Debuff lasting until the end of the attack. This does not grant Investigation. Then, if the Opponent has:
3+ Debuffs: Gain a [3,361.11] Resistance Up Passive, lasting for 2 seconds after the end of the attack.
5+ Debuffs: Gain an Unstoppable Passive, lasting for 2 seconds after the end of the attack.
10+ Debuffs: Gain an Unblockable Passive, lasting for 2 seconds after the end of the attack.
The duration of these effects is increased by 4 seconds flat when fighting as a Defender.
While Investigation is at 7 or more, Resistance Up and Unstoppable also activate during Jessica's Special Attacks, regardless of Debuffs on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On the last hit, Jessica randomly picks up whatever's handy and throws it at the Opponent, causing a different effect depending on what was thrown. Effects also trigger when Blocked.
Box: Inflict a Stun Debuff for 4 seconds.
Garbage Can: Inflict a Crush Debuff for 9 seconds.
Fire Hydrant: Inflict a 40% Suppression Debuff for 9 seconds.
Pallet: Inflict a [4,125] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 13 seconds.
Tire: Inflict a Rupture Debuff, dealing [21,119.4] Physical Damage over 9 seconds.
Propane Tank: Inflict Incinerate, dealing [21,119.4] Energy damage over 9 seconds. Incinerate removes Perfect Block chance, and lowers Block Proficiency by 50%.
Pizza: Jessica gains a Regeneration Passive, restoring [14,400.9] Health over 9 seconds.
The Kitchen Sink: Apply the effects from every other item, but potencies are reduced by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [8,213.1] for 10 seconds. Gain an additional Fury for each unique object Jessica has thrown with her Special Attack 1 in this fight. Max Fury Passives: 5.
These Fury Passives are paused during all Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Stun Debuff for 5 seconds.

Gain an indefinite non-stacking Indestructible Charge. The next time Jessica would be struck, the Charge is removed and she gains an Indestructible Passive for 2 seconds. Does not trigger against Special Attack 3.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Class Dossier
content: When Jessica reaches max Investigation, she gains a Dossier on the Opponent's Class, increasing her Combat Power Rate by [1 - 25]% while below 1 Bar of Power.
Dossiers are Cross-Fight, lasting for the rest of the Quest. Once Jessica has a Dossier on 3 different Classes, she also gains one on the Superior Class.
At the start of each fight, if Jessica already has her Opponent's Dossier, she gains 1 Investigation for every 50 signature levels obtained.
